A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it provides a method to calculate thermal Green functions in a general covariant gauge.
we have shown that the high temperature behavior of the QCD Green functions is governed by the forward scattering amplitude of the corresponding zero temperature Green functions.
the thermal gluon self-energy has been shown to be transversal in a covariant gauge and that the thermal gluons have been shown to satisfy the KMS condition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the thermal Green functions can be related to the forward scattering amplitudess of thermal particles.
the high temperature behavior of the gluon self-energy is not a problem in QCD.

the high-temperature expansion for the gluon propagator can be obtained from a forward scattering amplitude in a general covariant gauge, which can be calculated in the framework of the hard thermal loop (HTL) approximation.
